name: Veligandu — direct stay and dining enquiries
summary: Use the resort’s official contact channel to confirm dates, villa category, guest eligibility, meal inclusions, restaurant arrangements and cancellation terms before committing. An enquiry is not a confirmed room, table or island transfer; obtain confirmation for the arrangements you need.

name: The Sunshine Hotel & Suites — rooms and suites
summary: Compare studios, one-bedroom and connecting family suites near Seven Mile Beach. Kitchenettes are not all equipped with a cooktop; confirm your category, bedding, occupancy, access and total charges. The beachfront camera is at a sister property and does not establish a beachfront room or room availability at Sunshine.

name: Sunshine Grill — Grand Cayman
summary: The hotel’s own dining page identifies Sunshine Grill and links its restaurant website and reservations. Check current menus, dietary needs, opening times and table availability directly; sister-property dining access does not mean meals are included in your room rate.

name: Sunshine — resort charges and sister-property access
summary: Official guide distinguishes hotel amenities from beach, pool and selected spa facilities at the neighboring sister property. Confirm the current mandatory resort charge, taxes and booked entitlements; laundry, spa treatments and other services may cost extra. Access privileges do not establish current facility availability.

name: Sunshine — location and direct arrival enquiries
summary: The hotel’s official address is 1465 Esterley Tibbetts Highway, Seven Mile Beach, Grand Cayman. Use the appropriate hotel or grill contact to confirm driving directions, airport transport and booking arrangements; an enquiry is not a confirmed room, table or transfer. Verify current flight routes separately rather than relying on older airline text on the contact page.

name: TMS Hotel Da Nang Beach — room categories
summary: Compare the hotel’s city-view, partial-ocean and ocean-front categories rather than assuming every room faces My Khe Beach. Confirm actual bedding, occupancy, accessibility and total price for your dates; the destination photograph and beach camera do not establish your room view or availability.

name: Savour Restaurant — TMS breakfast dining
summary: The hotel’s dining page describes an international breakfast buffet with indoor and terrace seating. Check current service times, menus, dietary requirements and outside-guest access directly; confirm whether breakfast is included in your booked rate.

name: TMS — airport transfers and stay questions
summary: The official FAQ says airport transfers can be arranged on request for an additional charge, and parking is limited and subject to availability. Confirm the transfer quote, meeting arrangements, parking and any cot or accessibility needs before arrival; an enquiry is not a confirmed booking.

name: Nólsoy to Borðan — official walking guide
summary: Official route guidance describes a difficult walk with steep and wet terrain and cairns that can be hard to spot. Check current route access, maintenance, local weather and suitable preparation before setting out; maintenance material on the guide is not a current closure notice, and a village camera does not establish trail conditions.

name: Route 90 — Tórshavn to Nólsoy ferry
summary: Use the transport operator’s route 90 timetable to plan both outward and return sailings. Check your travel date, holiday exceptions, current service information and ticket and boarding requirements; leave a return margin rather than assuming the last ferry will suit a walk. A village view does not confirm a sailing.

name: Hida Hotel Plaza — Japanese and Western rooms
summary: The hotel’s English page describes Japanese- and Western-style room categories and in-house hot spring baths near Takayama Station. Confirm bedding, room accessibility, meal plan and total price for your dates; the Miyagawa photograph and river camera do not establish a room view or availability.

name: Restaurant Bonjour — Hida Hotel Plaza
summary: The hotel identifies Bonjour as its Western/French restaurant with seasonal local ingredients, lunch and other menu choices. Check your visit date, closures, current menus, dietary requirements and reservations directly; the monthly menu is not a year-round promise, and dining is not automatically included with a room.

name: Hida Hotel Plaza — station and arrival directions
summary: Official arrival guidance distinguishes regional rail, bus and driving routes and gives walking directions from Takayama Station’s east exit. Confirm current connections, winter road conditions and parking arrangements; published journey estimates do not guarantee your travel time. Hotel guest parking terms do not establish parking for all visitors.

name: Hida Hotel Plaza — bathing and accessibility questions
summary: The hotel FAQ says it does not offer day-use bathing and describes cleaning periods and bathing restrictions. Confirm current bath access, any specific room or mobility assistance and dietary needs before booking; available facilities and the winter river photograph do not guarantee present snow or unrestricted bathing.

name: Fairmont Chateau Whistler — rooms and suites
summary: Compare guest rooms, suites and the distinct Fairmont Gold offering at the base of Blackcomb Mountain. Confirm the actual view, bedding, accessibility, rate inclusions and dates directly; a Whistler Village cover or mountain camera is not evidence of your hotel room view, snow conditions or lift access.

name: The Wildflower — current dining location
summary: The restaurant’s page currently says Wildflower breakfast and dinner are being served in a dedicated area within Mallard Lounge. Confirm the present venue, menu, dietary needs and table availability before visiting. Parking validation excludes breakfast, and family dining offers have eligibility conditions; do not assume either is included.

name: Chateau Whistler — airport and driving arrival
summary: Official arrival guidance identifies the hotel at 4599 Chateau Boulevard and outlines travel from Vancouver International Airport. Check current transport reservations, road and weather conditions and parking charges before setting out; published drive-time estimates are not a guaranteed connection or transfer booking.

name: Chateau Whistler — accessible rooms and equipment
summary: The hotel describes accessible entrances and facilities plus equipment and adaptive arrangements available by request. Discuss your exact room, bathroom, transfer and assistance needs directly. Additional equipment can involve charges and requires confirmation of availability and delivery; an accessible category does not guarantee every activity suits your needs.

name: Addo Rest Camp — official accommodation
summary: SANParks identifies Main Camp as a base for accommodation and visitor facilities. Check the actual unit, self-catering facilities, accessibility, conservation charges and dates with the park. Overnight-only pool access is distinct from day visits; the historical elephant cover and waterhole camera do not guarantee wildlife sightings.

name: Mugg ’n Bean — temporary Addo dining
summary: The dedicated SANParks dining page announces Mugg ’n Bean from 1 October 2026, serving a limited menu from the Lapa across from the shop/restaurant during construction. Confirm current location, menu, dietary needs and operating arrangements directly; older camp overview text still naming Cattle Baron should not determine your dining plan.

name: Addo — entry documents and day-visit rules
summary: SANParks lists documentation requirements for entering and leaving, including identification and vehicle documents. Check the current rules, organised-activity arrangements and admission charges before travel. Day visits and overnight stays have different facility access; a camera view does not establish entry entitlement or a booked activity.

name: Addo — entrance gates and game-area access
summary: Choose the appropriate entrance gate and check its current entry and exit times with the park. SANParks distinguishes camp entrance gates from seasonal game-area gates and asks visitors to prepare registration documents. Arrange late arrival directly rather than assuming access; reaching a camp gate does not establish access to every game-viewing area.

name: Jinzun — viewpoint and beach restrictions
summary: The official scenic-area guide describes the coastal viewpoint and steps to the beach, and explicitly prohibits swimming because of the steep beach slope. Check current access, local warnings and weather before visiting; a calm-looking camera or historical photograph does not establish safe swimming or an open path.

name: Jinzun — rail, bus and accessible arrival
summary: The tourism authority outlines connections from Taitung station or bus station, with different Jinzun and Jinzun Recreation Area stops. Check current routes, return departures, seat reservations and the actual vehicle’s accessibility; low-floor service information does not guarantee every departure or step-free access down to the beach.

name: Oeschinensee Mountain Restaurant
summary: Lakeshore self-service restaurant with Swiss and regional dishes. Check the current menu, dietary requirements and service before walking down from the mountain station; group table arrangements are separate from cable-car reservations. A lake view does not confirm restaurant access or opening.

name: Oeschinensee Café-Bar
summary: Lakeshore café-bar offering ice cream and quick snacks. Confirm seasonal service and dietary suitability directly; do not assume a meal is included in a cable-car ticket or that the lakeshore is accessible whenever a camera image is visible.

name: Oeschinensee — choose a walking route
summary: Compare the mountain-station lake walk with the more demanding Heuberg and alpine routes. Check the operator’s route status, equipment guidance and return cable-car service for your visit date. Stroller suitability on selected paths does not establish wheelchair access throughout the area; photographs cannot establish trail safety.

name: Oeschinensee — rowing-boat planning
summary: The operator says rowing boats cannot be reserved and rental closes in fog, strong winds or bad weather. Check current operation, capacity, age rules and life-jacket guidance before visiting the lakeshore; a calm-looking cover photograph does not establish boating conditions.

name: Flåm Bakery
summary: Quayside bakery near Flåm Railway station offering breads, sandwiches, pastries and takeaway pizza. Check current opening, dietary suitability and ordering arrangements before a train or fjord departure; food and service availability are not established by the harbour camera.

name: Restaurant Arven at Fretheim Hotel
summary: Fretheim Hotel’s second-floor restaurant serves breakfast and dinner with seasonal Norwegian ingredients. Buffet service varies by season; lunch is offered to pre-booked groups. Confirm tables, dietary needs, access and any meal inclusion with the operator rather than assuming hotel or tour tickets include dining.

name: Flåm Railway — departure and connection planning
summary: Use the operator’s date-specific timetable and meet at Flåm Station. Distinguish a Flåm–Myrdal round trip from a one-way connection to the Bergen Railway; check the appropriate ticket and onward connection separately. Sold-out departures are not guaranteed by contacting customer service.

name: Nærøyfjord — cruise and return planning
summary: Check your sailing direction, quay and return bus or boat before booking a Flåm–Gudvangen cruise. Intermediate stops require advance booking. Winter route changes and vessel substitutions can affect the itinerary and accessibility; confirm the actual vessel and assistance needed rather than relying on a general accessible-ship description.

name: Flåm — luggage storage between journeys
summary: The operator lists self-service lockers beside Flåm’s station and Customer Center, with different sizes and card payment. Check current charges, rental limits and posted instructions at the lockers. A listed storage service does not guarantee an available box for your bag or departure time.

name: Glacier — entrances, roads and vehicle planning
summary: Choose the entrance for your intended valley and check the official road map before setting out. Seasonal roads, vehicle-size restrictions and full parking areas can change the route. Fuel before entering: there are no filling stations inside the park. A webcam view does not establish road access.

name: Glacier — mobility access by valley
summary: Compare accessible routes, restrooms and parking by valley rather than assuming all historic facilities meet current standards. The official guide describes paved Apgar paths and individual visitor facilities. Confirm the specific trail, building and assistance you need before choosing a route.

name: Glacier — Logan Pass seasonal shuttle planning
summary: The official 2026 Logan Pass service was ticketed and seasonal, with its listed season ending September 7. Use the park page to check the applicable season, assigned boarding location and ticket rules before relying on a shuttle. Plan your return and last departure; do not assume year-round service or a seat.

name: Glacier — day walks and trail closures
summary: Compare official area maps by distance and elevation gain, then check current trail closures and weather with the park. Save route information before leaving connected areas. Prepare for changing weather and wildlife; a scenic camera view does not establish that a hiking route is open or suitable.

name: Glacier — official maps for offline planning
summary: Use the official brochure and downloadable park maps to identify valleys, entrances and facilities before travel. Save a map for use without mobile coverage. Check current road and shuttle pages separately: a mapped road or stop does not guarantee seasonal access or service.

name: Russell’s Fireside Dining Room — Lake McDonald
summary: A Lake McDonald Lodge dining option listed by the operator for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The reviewed page describes first-come seating without reservations. Confirm seasonal operation, today’s meal service and dietary needs before travelling; no available table or year-round opening is implied.

name: Ptarmigan Dining Room — Many Glacier Hotel
summary: Dining at Many Glacier Hotel beside Swiftcurrent Lake, in a different valley from Lake McDonald. The operator describes first-come seating without reservations. Check seasonal road access, current meal service and dietary requirements before making the journey; a listed venue is not an available table.

name: Yellowstone — entrance and seasonal road planning
summary: Check the intended entrance and every road segment on the official status map before setting out. Most roads close to ordinary vehicles in winter; the northern year-round route does not establish access to Old Faithful or Biscuit Basin. Allow for construction, weather and closures that may not yet appear on the map.

name: Yellowstone — seasonal facilities and meal planning
summary: Compare the official operating dates for your chosen visitor center, food service, lodging and fuel stop. A park that remains open does not mean all facilities are open: services are limited in the colder months. Dates can change and daily hours need a separate check.

name: Biscuit Basin — closure and alternative-route checks
summary: At this review, the park report lists Biscuit Basin Trailhead closed due to thermal activity. Check the latest report and ranger advice before selecting an alternative route. The monitoring camera is a remote view, not evidence of visitor access; do not enter closed areas or use old trail directions.

name: Yellowstone — thermal-area and wildlife guidance
summary: Read the park’s thermal-area and wildlife guidance before visiting a geyser basin. Stay on designated boardwalks and trails, keep children close and do not touch thermal water or runoff. Follow current closures and wildlife-distance rules; a quiet camera scene does not establish safe access.

name: Yellowstone — access needs and visitor facilities
summary: Compare the official area-specific accessibility descriptions for routes, restrooms and visitor centers. Historic facilities and wilderness terrain can present barriers. Download NPS accessibility information before travel and arrange needed program assistance in advance; a general accessible listing does not describe every route.

name: Canyon Lodge Eatery — Yellowstone
summary: A seasonal food-hall option at Canyon Village, a separate park area from Biscuit Basin. The operator lists first-come seating and warns that dates, menus and hours can change. Check current road access and actual service for your visit; do not assume every counter or nearby café is open.

name: Old Faithful Snow Lodge — stay and winter-arrival planning
summary: The official park listing describes this concessioner-operated stay near the Upper Geyser Basin. Winter access is by commercially operated snowcoach or snowmobile, not an ordinary drive-in arrival. Confirm season dates, transport booking and the specific room’s accessibility with the operator; no room or transfer is included or guaranteed.
